item.description: Section 163.3177(3)(b), Florida Statutes, requires the City to annually update the Five-Year Capital Improvement Program (CIP) contained within the Capital Improvements Element (CIE) of the Comprehensive Plan. State law requires all local governments to include a CIE in their Comprehensive Plans to address the need for and location of public facilities. The CIE must establish principles for the construction, extension, or expansion of public facility capacity, as well as strategies for correcting existing public facility deficiencies necessary to implement the Comprehensive Plan. The planning horizon for the CIE is five (5) years.
